src.core.statistics.amount_trains
=================================

.. py:module:: src.core.statistics.amount_trains

.. autoapi-nested-parse::

   This module computes from given departure and arrival stations, the ratio of delayed
   at departure and arrival, and cancelled trains. The ratio is computed
   from the amount of delayed/cancelled trains over the total planned trains on a given
   period.



Functions
---------

.. autoapisummary::

   src.core.statistics.amount_trains.get_ratio_cancelled_trains
   src.core.statistics.amount_trains.get_total_planned_trains
   src.core.statistics.amount_trains.get_ratio_delayed_departure_trains
   src.core.statistics.amount_trains.get_ratio_delayed_arrival_trains


Module Contents
---------------

.. py:function:: get_ratio_cancelled_trains(departure_station: str, arrival_station: str, start_month: int, end_month: int, years_list: numpy.array, data_df: pandas.DataFrame | None = None) -> float

   Calculate the ratio of cancelled trains
   to the total number of planned trains
   over a period, given a departure and arrival stations.

   The ratio is calculated using only valid monthly observations.

   :param departure_station: departure station
   :type departure_station: str
   :param arrival_station: arrival station
   :type arrival_station: str
   :param start_month: start month of period
   :type start_month: int
   :param end_month: end month of period
   :type end_month: int
   :param years_list: selected years list
   :type years_list: np.array
   :param data_df: input dataframe with MONTH, YEAR, DEPARTURE_STATION_KEY
   :type data_df: pd.DataFrame
   :param and ARRIVAL_STATION_KEY columns:

   :returns:

             the ratio of cancelled trains
                 to the total number of planned trains
                 over a period between two given stations,
                 or NaN if no valid observations are available
   :rtype: cancelled_trains_ratio (float)


.. py:function:: get_total_planned_trains(departure_station: str, arrival_station: str, start_month: int, end_month: int, years_list: numpy.array, data_df: pandas.DataFrame | None = None) -> int

   Calculate the ratio of delayed trains at departure
   to the total number of planned trains,
   over a selected period and
   given a departure and arrival stations.

   The ratio is calculated using only valid monthly observations.

   :type departure_station: str
   :param arrival_station: arrival station
   :type arrival_station: str
   :param start_month: start month of period
   :type start_month: int

   :param years_list: selected years list
   :type years_list: np.array
   :param data_df: input dataframe with MONTH, YEAR, DEPARTURE_STATION_KEY
   :type data_df: pd.DataFrame
   :param and ARRIVAL_STATION_KEY columns:

   :returns: the ratio of delayed trains
             at departure to the total number of planned trains
             over a period between two given stations,
             or NaN if no valid observations are available.
   :rtype: delayed_departure_trains_ratio (float)
